payload.name: Flaim Fantasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flaim connects ChatGPT to a user's ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues so ChatGPT can answer questions about current leagues, standings, rosters, matchups, drafts and draft-pick ownership, available players, player search, recent league moves, league info, and past seasons using the user's actual league context. Ten of its eleven tools are read-only. The eleventh, refresh_leagues, is a bounded write that re-discovers leagues through the user's connected accounts and updates only Flaim's own connected-league registry. Flaim never makes trades, adds or drops players, edits lineups, or modifies league data on ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper. This application uses fantasy data provided by Yahoo Fantasy.
payload.longDescription: Flaim将ChatGPT连接到用户的ESPN、Yahoo和Sleeper幻想联赛，使ChatGPT能够根据用户的实际联赛情境，回答关于当前联赛、排名、阵容、对阵情况、选秀和选秀权归属、可用球员、球员搜索、近期联赛操作、联赛信息以及过往赛季的问题。其11个工具中有10个为只读模式。第11个工具refresh_leagues为有限写入模式，会通过用户的连接账户重新发现联赛，并仅更新Flaim自身的已连接联赛注册表。Flaim永远不会在ESPN、Yahoo或Sleeper上进行交易、添加或删除球员、编辑阵容或修改联赛数据。该应用程序使用Yahoo Fantasy提供的幻想数据。

payload.name: Daily Tarot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kick-start your tarot reading right inside ChatGPT. Ask AI Tarot to shuffle digital tarot cards, lay a three-card spread, and return clear, private divination insights—no ads or waiting rooms.

How to Use Tarot in ChatGPT

1. Connect: Connect the Tarot app to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type Commands: Simply type "@" then choose the Tarot app, or type “Tarot” (followed by a space) in the chat box.
3. Create: You are ready to go! Try asking specifically:
"Pull tarot cards for my love life."
"Draw three tarot cards and interpret the spread for my upcoming week."
“Provide a three-card tarot reading on balancing work and health.”

Want to dive deeper? Keep asking follow-ups in chat or open the full app for richer symbolism and saved readings.
payload.longDescription:
直接在ChatGPT内开启塔罗占卜。
让AI塔罗洗牌、摆放三张牌阵，并返回清晰私密的占卜洞察——无广告无等待界面。

如何在ChatGPT中使用塔罗

1.
连接：将塔罗应用与ChatGPT连接。
2.
触发：输入指令：在聊天框中输入"@"后选择塔罗应用，或直接输入“Tarot”（后接空格）。
3.
创建：即可开始使用！
尝试具体提问：
“为我的感情生活抽塔罗牌。”
“抽取三张塔罗牌并解读我下周的牌阵。”
“为平衡工作与健康提供三张牌占卜。”

想深入探索？
在聊天中继续提出后续问题，或打开完整应用获取更丰富的象征意义和保存的占卜记录。

payload.name: Open Ephemeris
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Open Ephemeris gives ChatGPT real astronomy to work from. Every position comes from the NASA JPL DE440 ephemeris covering 1550-2650 CE at sub-arcsecond precision, the same kernel used for spacecraft navigation, so positions are computed rather than estimated.

Ask for a natal chart and an interactive wheel opens in the conversation. Click a planet, a house, or an aspect line and the interpretation loads in place. Switch house systems without asking again. The same applies to Human Design bodygraphs, synastry bi-wheels, transit timelines, Vedic Rashi grids and BaZi Four Pillars charts.

Beyond charts: transits and progressions, solar and lunar returns, eclipse timing and local visibility, astrocartography, electional search for timing windows, and fixed-star positions.

Free to start, no card required.
payload.longDescription:
Open Ephemeris为ChatGPT提供真实的天文学数据。
每个天体位置均源自NASA JPL DE440星历表，覆盖公元1550-2650年，精度达到亚角秒级，该星历表同样用于航天器导航，因此天体位置是通过计算得出而非估算。

输入生辰星盘请求后，对话中将打开交互式星盘。
点击行星、宫位或相位线，对应解读内容会直接加载。
切换宫位系统时无需重复提问。
以上功能同样适用于人神设计身体图、合盘双轮、星体推进时间线、印度占星拉希网格和八字四柱图。

超越星盘：包含相位推进、日月回归、日食时间与本地可见性、占星地图、择时窗口搜索以及恒星位置等功能。

免费使用，无需提供信用卡信息。

payload.name: Destiny AI Astrology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The world's most advanced AI astrologer for accurate birth charts, detailed horoscopes, and personalized guidance for love life, career and life path. Ask Destiny anything and get tailored insights based on your unique astrology chart.
payload.longDescription: 全球最先进的 AI 占星师，为你提供准确的出生星盘、详尽的星座运势，以及针对爱情、事业和人生道路的个性化指引。向 Destiny 提出任何问题，它都会根据你的专属星盘提供量身定制的见解。
